notes.title: Keyboard Input Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32262826/35fc0658d0f78267a51df3b6dd4767b9af4499e5.gif

Hey everyone!

I am happy to bring you this new update, with game changing feature that was suggested by one of our players (thank you Luna!).

Let me quickly run through this.

First, you can simply type words with your keyboard, and letters will connect automatically. Then press Enter (Return) to score the word. Super easy!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32262826/87cc2ff55db86754a77ad00975ad45686cea259a.gif

If you made a mistake, you can use backspace to disconnect the last letter, then continue typing as usual.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32262826/71c2390fea5b6a82d1d8b86e664231f25bf7ca11.gif

It's also possible to break whole word apart by pressing Delete.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32262826/abe4dcefc43bde7b12ce0e9afd4a83b8811df4a5.gif

And when you have a challenge in progress, it's never been easier to take a peak at the requirements. Just press space to toggle the challenge panel view.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32262826/1998b1e2cadb4ac2bfc68074345376c6ee80987a.gif

Also, notifications, definitions and other popups can be closed with Enter (Return) key. Hint can be toggled with F1, Escape will bring you into the menu, TAB will toggle between light and dark mode.

You can now play the game with keyboard only!

In addition to that, a couple of minor bugs were fixed with this update. Thanks everyone, I hope you will enjoy the new and improved version of Relaxicon!

Oh, and I've got a couple of extra good news for you. First, I've just released a free version of my Bloody Rally Show game, you can play it right away:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1435090/Bloody_Rally_Show_Prologue/

And if you're into base building colony sims like RimWorld or Prison Architect, you may want to wishlist and follow my next game that should be out on Early Access some time next year.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32262826/9f5a1bff3a6018ad73d55eded76c4a50001c7f63.gif

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1380910/Stardeus/

Cheers!
spajus

notes.title: Stats, Achievements & Leaderboards
notes.content:
Relaxicon has finally received the long overdue Steam integration features: Stats, Leaderboards and 26 Achievements (one for each letter of the alphabet).

A few more minor changes sneaked into this update as well. Here is the full list of changes:

Version 1.10.0

 Track various Steam stats for Leaderboards and Achievements
 Add 26 Steam Achievements
 Add "Challenges Solved" Steam Leaderboard
 Add "High Score" Steam Leaderboard
 Add "Words Scored" Steam Leaderboard
 Add "Letters Scored" Steam Leaderboard
 Add "Lifetime Score" Steam Leaderboard
 Add a setting to disable random letter motion
 Increase valid range of mouse wheel scroll zoom
 Inverse mouse wheel scroll for more intuitive zooming

notes.title: Relaxicon: Quality Of Life Update
notes.content:
It has been nearly two years after Relaxicon was released, and there were no updates afterwards. Some have encountered a bug with lowercase letters that are impossible to use in a word, others wanted more letters on screen to be able to build longer, more sophisticated words. 

In this Relaxicon QOL update I've addressed all the issues you've encountered, and added a couple of other small improvements.

Here is the list of recent changes (version 1.9.0):

 Fixed the bug with unusable lowercase letters
 After every 3 challenges you will have one more letter on screen
 Fixed letter jitter that happened when you dragged the word quickly
 Made it easier to snap letters together
 Menu cog will become larger when mouse is over it
 Unity was upgraded to latest and greatest stable version (from 2017.3 to 2019.2)
 Added separate Windows 64-bit and 32-bit builds
 Dropped support for 32-bit Linux build (because Unity 2019.2 does not support it anymore)


And in following couple of weeks I am hoping to add Steam Achievements, so stay tuned!
